content: Taciang Pilate in amate biakpiakna taw Galilee te thisan hel hi, ci in Jesus kungah a son pawlkhat om hi.
Jesus in amate tungah hibang in zo hi,

content.text: Hi Galilee mite sia tabang a thuak uh hu in, a dang Galilee mite theampo sang in mawzaw uh hi, ci in ngaisun nu ziam?
Kong ci hi, hi ngawl hi: ahihang noma zong na ki sikkik bua uh le, na vekpi in tabangma in na lalcip tu uh hi.
Siloam tausang cim in hukcip a, a thi sawm le liat te, Jerusalem a teang ngualdang te sang in mawzaw uh hi, ci in ngaisun nu ziam?
Kong son hi, hi ngawl hi: ahihang note zong na ki sikkik bua uh le, na vekpi in tabangma in na lalcip tu uh hi,

content: Jesus in hi sontena zong son hi;

content.text: Mi khat in a sapit huan sungah theikung khat suan hi; taciang a nga zong tu in hongpai a, khat zong mu ngawl hi.

Taciang in sapit huan cing te tung ah, en in, hi theikung tungah a nga zong tu in ka pai a, kum thum sung khat zong mu ngawl khi hi: phuk lel in; banghang in leitang deap lel in koi tu hi ziam? ci hi.
Huan cing pa in, Topa awng, tu kum sung om hi lai po hen, a kiim teng pan lei taw tu khi hi, taciang eaklei pia phot hi lai tu khi hi:
Hong nga a hile, pha hi: taciang hong nga bua a hi le tua zawkciang phuk in, ci hi,

content: Jesus sabbath ni khat synagogue khat sungah thuhil hi.

Taciang, en vun, cinasak doai in kum sawm le kum liat sung zawngkhal in a thaneamsak numei khat om hi, taciang ama sia a cing zong bawng a, bangbang po in a om zong ama le ama ki mamsak thei ngawl hi.
Tua nu Jesus in a mu ciang in, a kungah sam a,

content.text: Nu mei awng, na natna pan in na suakta zo hi,

content: Jesus in a tungah a khut nga hi: ta sia pociang thakhat thu in ding tang thei a, Pathian pok hi.
Jesus in sabbath ni in a damsak hu in, synagogue lampui pa a thin-uk a, ni luk sung nasep tu sia a ngeina hi: tua ahikom tua ni luk sung in hongpai tavun, sabbath ni in hongpai heak vun, ci hi.

content.text: Nang a ki hitheamsak pa, note sungah khatpo, sabbath ni in na khui uh a hibale, na laa uh a khau sut in, tui dawn tu in paipui hi ngawl nu ziam?
Kum sawm le kum liat sung Satan hencip, Abraham tanu sia tua a ki hencip napan sabbath ni in suatak tu hi ngawl ziam?

content: Hi teng a son zawkciang in, a ngal te theampo maizum in om uh hi: taciang Jesus in a vawt nalamdang te hang in mi theampo lungdam uh hi.

content.text: Pathian kumpingam sia bangtaw kibang ziam? bangtaw sonte tu khi ziam?
Mi khat in ankamci la a, huansung ah a poai taw kibang hi; tua anci hong khang a, thingkung lianpui hong suak hi; a bak te tungah van a vacim te ngiak hi.

content: Jesus in son thua kik a,

content.text: Pathian kumpingam sia bangtaw sonte tu khi ziam?
Nupi khat in tol la a, an hui law thum sungah hel hi, tua tol in an hui theampo a thosak taw kibang hi.

content: Jesus Jerusalem sangah pai a, khuapi le khuano tampi ah pai in thuhil hi.
Khat hongpai a, Topa awng, ngupna a nga tu mihing tawmbek a hi ziam? ci in dong hi. Tasiaciang Jesus in,

content.text: Kongkha ciak na pan tum tu in hanciam vun: banghangziam cile mihing tampi te tum tu hanciam napi, a tum thei bua uh hi.

Innteakpa topa sia khat vei tho a, kongkha a kha zawkciang in, note a puasang ah ding in kongkha na king uh a, Topa, Topa awng, kong hong hon tan; na ci uh ciang in, Topa in, koisung pan hongpai nu ziam, hong he ngei ngawl khi hi, hong ci tu hi:
Tasiaciang in, note in, na mai ah an ne tui dawn in om khu hi, taciang ka lampi uh ah zong thuhil ni hi, ci tu uh hi.
Ahihang ama in, hong son khi hi, kong pan hongpai nu ziam, hong he ngawl khi hi; no na phangawl seam te, ka kung pan tai tavun, ci tu hi.
Abraham, Isaac, Jacob le kamsang theampo te sia Pathian kumpingam sungah na mu uh ciang in, note a puasang ah hong vawk tu a, tua mun ah kaana le ha ngoaina om tu hi.
Amate nisua na sang, nitum na sang, sak le thang pan in hongpai tu uh a, Pathian kumpingam sungah to tek tu uh hi.
Taciang, en vun, a khakbel te masabel tu a, a masabel te nungkhakbel tu hi,

content: Tua ni in Pharisee pawlkhat te Jesus kungah hongpai uh a, hi mun pan pusuak in a, pai in: banghangziam cile Herod in hong that tu hi, ci uh hi.
Taciang Jesus in amate tung ah,

content.text: Pai tavun a, tua ngia tungah son vun, en in, doai te hawlkhia khi hi, taciang tuni le zingciang cina te damsak khi hi, taciang nithum na ciang in ka cialcing tu hi.
Ahihang tu ni, zingciang le thai ciang vak hamtang tu khi hi: banghangziam cile kamsang khat sia Jerusalem puasang ah lalcip thei ngawl hi.
Maw Jerusalem, Jerusalem awng, kamsang te na that a, na tungah a ki sawl te suangtum taw na deang hi; akpui in a note a tha nuai ah a uap bang in, tamvei mama hong uap nuam ka hi hang, na uk bua hi!
En vun, na inn uh dap khipkhep in ki nusia tu hi: a mantak kong ci ciang, Topa min taw hongpai pa thuphatoai a hihi, na ci uh mateng, note in hong mu nawn ngawl tu nu hi,
